skills.trigger: When evaluating a well-defined, homogeneous soft-tissue density mass in the mediastinum (specifically paratracheal) on CT to determine benign versus malignant etiology.
steps: Assess the margin definition and internal homogeneity of the mass; benign cysts typically appear smooth, well-circumscribed, and uniform in density.
Evaluate the interface with adjacent critical structures (e.g., trachea, esophagus); look for 'abutting' without luminal narrowing, deviation, or invasion.
Distinguish from malignancy by confirming the absence of irregular borders, fat stranding, or compressive mass effect on the airway.
